en.ui.scan_fit.bad_angle: Enter a region angle from 0 to 180 degrees.
en.ui.scan_fit.bad_boundary: Enter a nonnegative boundary simplification distance; use 0 mm to retain all boundary edges.
en.ui.scan_fit.bad_flow: Enter a nonzero finite flow vector.
en.ui.scan_fit.boundary_help: The CAD sheet follows the selected region boundary. Use 0 mm simplification to retain every boundary edge. Select one surface layer; split overlapping or folded regions into separate patches.
en.ui.scan_fit.fairing_help: Fairing smooths the freeform control net. Higher values may increase the fitting error; check the measured result.
en.ui.scan_fit.flow_help: Set the main surface direction to follow the panel. The vector uses world coordinates, not the camera.
en.ui.scan_fit.lasso_help: Draw a loop around one surface patch, then fit a bounded CAD sheet.
en.ui.scan_fit.need_region: Pick a facet in a connected region, or lasso a patch. An entire scan is not selected automatically.
en.ui.scan_fit.no_recipe: This surface has no saved scan fitting recipe.
en.ui.scan_fit.outside: Measured samples exceed the target error — refit or split the region
en.ui.scan_fit.refitting: Refitting surface feature {feature}; the saved scan patch is retained.
en.ui.scan_fit.region_help: Pick a facet on the surface region to fit, or choose Lasso patch to draw its boundary.
en.ui.scan_fit.sample_note: These residuals describe sampled scan points, not a certified maximum deviation over the complete surface.
en.ui.scan_fit.within: Measured samples are within the target error
